paper_title: RLHF Workflow From Reward Modeling to Online RLHF
caption: The training record of reward modeling. From the left to right, we present the records of training loss, gradient norm, and the learning rate, respectively.
model_annotation: The line plot illustrates the training loss of a reward model over the course of training, with the x-axis representing the training step ranging from 0 to 1400 and the y-axis showing the training loss on a scale from 0.3 to 0.75. The plot displays a single blue line labeled "Training Loss of Reward Model," which begins at a high loss value of approximately 0.75 at step 0. The loss rapidly decreases during the initial steps, dropping sharply to around 0.4 by step 100. After this initial drop, the loss continues to decline more gradually, stabilizing around 0.32 to 0.34 with minor fluctuations for the remainder of the training process, indicating convergence. The gridlines and clear labeling facilitate the interpretation of the loss trajectory over time.
